atoms.b: Policewomen and firewomen help keep people safe. Policewomen make sure people obey the law. They can stop cars and direct traffic. A firewoman’s job is to put out fires and rescue people. They also teach people about fire safety. Firewomen and policewomen have dangerous jobs.
